scripts.dev: JENDAL_LOCAL_STAGE=dev varlock run -- alchemy dev --stage dev
scripts.dev:preprod: JENDAL_LOCAL_STAGE=preprod varlock run -- alchemy dev --stage preprod
scripts.deploy:staging: JENDAL_DEPLOY_STAGE=staging varlock run -- alchemy deploy --stage staging --yes
scripts.deploy:production: JENDAL_DEPLOY_STAGE=production varlock run -- alchemy deploy --stage production --yes
scripts.destroy:staging: JENDAL_DEPLOY_STAGE=staging varlock run -- alchemy destroy --stage staging --yes
